title: Little Helper: Set the Table
description: Help Pip prepare four places for breakfast, a picnic, or dinner.
learningGoals: Learn stable center, left, right, and above place-setting relationships
Match familiar household objects to silhouettes and picture guides
Rehearse a real household responsibility with an achievable four-place routine
interactionModel: direct drag with an equal tap-to-place path
feedbackModel: success pop and sparkle with spoken praise; gentle wobble and spoken spatial nudge on retry; playful distractor response
